title: Entity Definitions
description: Schema for entity and resource definitions used by the REE Content Editor. Defines patchable resources and entity groupings for game-specific content editing.

entities.description: Top-level entity type definitions. Each key is the entity type name used as a prefix for resource paths and UI grouping.

additionalProperties.description: Entity type configuration including enum definitions, display string format, and field definitions.

to_string.description: SmartFormat expression for generating a preview string of the entity type when collapsed. May reference enum values and entity fields.

primary_field.description: Name of the primary field used for the entity ID. If unspecified, the first field is used.

id_field.description: The field to use for determining the entity ID. Defaults to using the primary field.

enums.description: Custom enum definitions for this entity type. Each defines a new enum entry set with display label format.

fields.description: List of fields that make up this entity type. Each field maps to a resource with optional enum overrides and display options.

resources.description: Resource type definitions. Each defines how a resource is loaded from files and its properties.

additionalProperties.description: Resource type configuration including file sources, ID fields, and linked resources.
String format configuration for a C# class.

to_string.description: SmartFormat expression for generating display strings. May reference enum values, entity fields, and translation keys.

fields.description: Additional per-field settings to further customize how a class display and edits.

enum.description: Enum classname override for displaying this field instead of its default

translate_guid.description: Whether to use the GUID property for translation lookup.

translate_fallback_enum.description: Enum to use as fallback for translation when GUID translation fails.

readOnly.description: Whether this field should be read-only in the UI.

tooltip.description: Tooltip text shown when hovering over the field.

handler.description: Custom handler name for special field formatting (e.g., 'DD2.ArmorStyle').

entityField.description: Field definition within an entity type. Maps to a resource with optional enum formatting and display options.

name.description: Field name as used in SmartFormat expressions and code access.

type.description: Resource type name that matches an entry in the resources section. Can be a custom type defined inline via field_type.

label.description: Display label shown in the UI for this field.

label_type.description: Type of label: 'string' for literal text or 'field' to use a nested field as label. Deprecated in favor of resource.label.

field_type.description: Custom field type for inline resource definitions. When set, type becomes ignored and params define the resource.

field_id.description: Field ID specification for multi-variant fields. Maps field names to their value paths.

path.description: Path within the resource object for ID lookup.

value.description: Literal value to use as ID when no field is specified.

required.description: Whether this field is required when creating a new entity. Affects UI validation and creation flow.

display_after.description: Field name to wait for before displaying this field in the UI. Used for conditional field ordering.

display_after_start.description: Alias for display_after showing field should appear after all other fields are filled (start of editing session).

display_after_end.description: Alias for display_after showing field should appear before other fields (end of editing session).

when.description: Custom condition to determine whether this field should be used.

resource.description: Inline resource configuration for this field. Supports file paths, ID fields, and nested resource references.

resourceConfig.description: Inline resource configuration within a field definition.

custom_id_range.description: Single file path for this resource.

subclasses.description: List of RSZ subclasses of this resource. Used by the group resource type to merge multiple classes into one resource with a shared ID pool

resources.description: List of subresources referenced by this resource.

file.description: Single file path for this resource.

files.description: Array of file paths for array-file resources.

id.description: Array of field names that uniquely identify this resource.

to_string.description: SmartFormat expression for generating display strings. May reference enum values, resource fields, and translation keys. If unspecified, the ID and resource's ToString() is used instead.

classname.description: C# class name of the resource type.

field.description: Field name within file for resource identification.

display_name.description: The name to display in the category UI for this resource.

resource_type.description: The file format type to use for this resource when applicable. Matches RE-Engine-Lib's KnownFileFormats enum in camelCase.

parent_resource.description: The parent resource type. Denotes that this resource relies on another resource existing and inherits its ID from the parent.

not_standalone.description: If true, resource will be hidden from the Resources window and can only be edited through an entity.

enums.description: Custom enum definitions for this resource type.

regex.description: Regex pattern for generating translation keys from field values.

regexDescription.description: Tooltip explaining the regex pattern for string fields.

regexDescriptionFormat.description: SmartFormat string for customizing regexDescription. Uses {params} placeholder.

initial.description: Initial value for string fields, enum references, or other fields.

diffable.description: Whether this field can be partially patched (true) or requires full replacement (false).

multiline.description: Whether the field accepts multi-line text (for msg resources).

key_format.description: SmartFormat string for generating translation key from ID or other fields.

key_pattern.description: Regex pattern for extracting ID from translation keys.

virtual_enum_name.description: Name of a virtual enum for enum_mapping resource types. IDs are generated dynamically.

new_label_format.description: SmartFormat string for enum labels in enum_mapping resources.

label_id_parse.description: Regex pattern for parsing existing label IDs from translation keys.

value_from.description: Source field and path for enum value. Used with enum_mapping.

enumInfo.description: Enum definition for entity types. Defines new enum entries with custom display labels.

name.description: Enum type name referenced in SmartFormat expressions.

format.description: SmartFormat string for formatting enum values. Uses {id} for the raw ID value.

primary.description: Whether this enum's display labels should be used as the primary entity label. Overrides enum value labels.

field.description: The field that determines this subresource's ID

name.description: The user-facing name to use for the subresource

key.description: The storage property name to use for this subresource

when.description: Custom condition to determine whether this subresources should be used.

resourceCondition.description: Conditional loading specification for fields and resources.

property.description: Nested property within the field object to compare.

classname.description: Exact classname to match. When specified, property and equals are ignored.

equals.description: Value to compare against (enum name or literal value). Used with property.
